entries.heading: TEMPORARY EXEMPTION FROM AUTHORIZED DAILY AVERAGE OF MEMBERS IN PAY GRADES E-8 AND E-9
ancestors: TITLE IX—DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE ORGANIZATION AND MANAGEMENT
entries.text:
SEC. 929. TEMPORARY EXEMPTION FROM 
                        AUTHORIZED DAILY AVERAGE OF MEMBERS IN PAY 
                        GRADES E-8 AND E-9.

    Section 517 of title 10, United States Code, shall not apply to the 
Space Force until October 1, 2023.
